answer: At epoch dawn a public beacon seeds a sequential hash-chain that must traverse a canyon of 2^12 intermediate steps. Each agent computes a private chain incorporating its identity and last three attestations, then publishes a compact proof. Peers sample random mid-points for verification. Strictly sequential work means an attacker with N sybils pays N times the wall-clock compute and storage; parallel hardware cannot compress the depth. The shale of prior history binds the chain so clones sharing a farm collapse under mismatched checkpoints.
